en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 issued as Saudel becomes tropical depression
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the signal at 6.10pm after the remnant of the former typhoon intensified; it is expected to stay in force until at least noon on Tuesday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Standby Signal, No. 1, at 6.10pm on Monday as the remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel intensified into a tropical depression over the northern part of the South China Sea.

At 10pm the system was centred about 460 kilometres southwest of Hong Kong near 18.9 degrees north, 111.6 degrees east, and was forecast to move east or east-northeast at about 22 kilometres per hour.

The Observatory said the signal would remain in force until at least noon on Tuesday. Local winds are expected to strengthen as Saudel edges closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong, and the need for the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 will be assessed according to its intensity and proximity.
Showers are expected to be heavier in parts of Hong Kong on Tuesday. The Thunderstorm Warning that had been in force earlier in the evening was cancelled at 10.10pm.

zh.headline: 沙德爾增強為熱帶低氣壓 天文台發出一號戒備信號
zh.dek: 天文台傍晚6時10分因沙德爾殘餘增強為熱帶低氣壓而發出一號戒備信號，預料信號至少維持至周二中午。
body: 香港天文台於周一傍晚6時10分發出一號戒備信號，因前颱風沙德爾的殘餘在南海北部增強為熱帶低氣壓。
晚上10時，該系統位於香港西南約460公里，即北緯18.9度、東經111.6度附近，預料以每小時約22公里速度向東或東北偏東移動。
天文台表示，信號至少維持至周二中午。隨着沙德爾逐漸靠近廣東東部沿岸，本港風力預料會增強，當局會視乎其強度、強風範圍與珠江口的距離，以及本港風力變化，評估是否需要發出三號強風信號。
預料周二本港部分地區雨勢較大。早前生效的雷暴警告已於晚上10時10分取消。
